# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_WITH_VIX_CONFIRMATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-02
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT setup captures a directional edge when SPY breaks out above a descending trendline, confirmed by a rising VIX. This combination of technical and market-sentiment indicators may provide a high-probability trade.

## Mechanism

1. Identify a descending trendline with at least two touches.
2. Wait for SPY to break out above the trendline.
3. Confirm the breakout with a rising VIX (5-bar slope ≥ 0).
4. Enter a long position (calls) when the breakout and VIX confirmation coincide.
5. Exit when the trendline is retested and holds, or when a predefined stop-loss is triggered.
